baseline_models.focus_anchor: The definite noun-adjective construction anchors the reading in النبإ at word 2 and العظيم at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The head noun presents brought, knowledge-bearing news, while the adjective gives that communication magnitude and force; greatness is consequential efficacy, not mere verbal length.

activation_trace.role: News brought and reported supplies the incoming communication and its capacity to yield knowledge or strong probability.
Greatness and strength make the report weighty enough to exert consequential force.

changed_reading.before: A report described only as very large or important.
changed_reading.after: A brought report whose weight lies in producing consequential knowledge and forcefully altering its hearers' situation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reading remains attached to النبإ as an arrival branch and العظيم as a severe-event branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase permits a metonymic slide from the report to what it reports: movement or emergence arrives bearing a grave, overwhelming event.

activation_trace.role: Coming from one place to another makes the report an arrival and lets its referent approach rather than remain abstract.
The grave calamity image supplies the severe event carried by that arrival.

changed_reading.after: The announcement of an overwhelming happening already figured as coming into the hearers' world.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The report noun and the adjective's branch of finding something alarming or too great jointly anchor the model.
baseline_models.mechanism: Greatness is relational as well as objective: a consequential report becomes 'great' in the act of exceeding, alarming, or overwhelming its recipients' present capacity to assimilate it.

activation_trace.role: The consequential reported news supplies the epistemic object presented to recipients.
Finding a matter overwhelming or alarming locates part of the report's greatness in recipient response.

changed_reading.before: The adjective states an objective rank of importance.
changed_reading.after: The adjective also registers the report's overwhelming pressure on minds that encounter it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal inquiry circulates the report socially, disagreement sends participants down different paths, and repeated future knowing closes that divergence with disclosure. The focus phrase therefore names an epistemic transition, not a static topic.

activation_trace.role: Brought and reported news supplies the disputed knowledge-bearing content.
The overwhelming-matter image explains why recipients recoil into dispute rather than simply absorb the report.
Mutual questioning supplies the social circulation through which the report is repeatedly reopened.
Each taking a path unlike another turns circulation into divergent readings.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the endpoint that replaces present divergence with known reality.

structural_cues: 78:1-3 places the focus phrase between reciprocal questioning and a relative clause of disagreement.
78:4-5 repeats the same future knowing clause, with the second occurrence delayed by ثم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal inquiry, divergent paths, and doubled future knowing; I infer a trajectory from circulating uncertainty to compelled disclosure. A live alternative is that the repetition threatens consequence without specifying resolution of the disputed content.

changed_reading.before: A great subject about which people happen to ask.
changed_reading.after: A socially contested report whose greatness includes its power to carry divided hearers from inquiry into unavoidable disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeatedly assigned states, prepared supports, a daily cutting-off, and hidden-to-visible growth form a chain of transformations. That chain makes the arriving report materially rehearsed in ordinary created processes before its extraordinary fulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Movement, emergence, and arrival let the focus report be modeled as a transition into visibility.
Greatness and strength scale the familiar transformations toward the report's exceptional transition.
Rendering something into a state supplies the repeated transformation operator of the created-order sequence.
Preparing and leveling a matter makes the earth a deliberately readied support rather than inert scenery.
Peg-like upright stability supplies the fixed condition against which later transition can register.
Cutting and removal make daily sleep a recurring interruption rather than only passive rest.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the explicit hidden-to-visible arrow.
Plant life emerging from earth gives that arrow a recurring material instance.

structural_cues: 78:6-16 accumulates coordinated acts of making, building, sending down, and bringing out.
The purpose construction at 78:15 links descending water to the emergence of seed and vegetation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate state-making, interruption, and emergence from concealment; I infer that their sequence rehearses the report's arrival and plausibility. The live alternative is that the sequence establishes present beneficence without analogizing the future report.

changed_reading.before: A verbal claim detached from present material experience.
changed_reading.after: An arriving transformation whose logic is already rehearsed by prepared supports, recurring interruption, and concealed life brought forth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded appointment turns the report into a scheduled separation; collective arrival, opened sky, and displaced mountains then enact a system-wide reversal of ordinary boundaries and stability.

activation_trace.role: Arrival and emergence let the news point metonymically to the event entering actuality.
The grave calamity image supplies the severity of the appointed reversal.
The day's severe happening gives the report a concentrated event horizon.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood turns the day into decisive differentiation.
Fixing a time or limit makes the report's event appointed rather than indefinitely remote.
Coming and arrival realizes the focus root's movement as the gathering of its recipients.
The opening and widening of what was closed removes the upper boundary of the ordinary order.
Displacement and removal undo the apparent fixity of the mountains.
A mirage shining like water converts the former solid landmark into deceptive appearance.

structural_cues: 78:17 announces an appointed day before 78:18-20 unfolds a tightly sequenced series of transformations.
The stable mountains of 78:7 return in 78:20 as displaced mirage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, separation, arrival, opening, and displacement; I infer that these are phases of the event carried by the focus report. A live alternative keeps the focus noun as report only and treats the event sequence solely as its later subject matter.

changed_reading.before: A generally momentous report about an unspecified future.
changed_reading.after: A report whose referent is an appointed separating arrival that reverses the world's normal boundaries and apparent solids.

context_deltas.mechanism: Matching recompense, reckoning, exhaustive registration, protected escape, and measured gift form one bilateral settlement. This revises the grave-calamity baseline: the report is great because it settles the whole field of action, not because it forecasts pain alone.

activation_trace.role: Consequential reported news supplies the public announcement of the settlement.
The severe calamity branch remains live for one side of the settlement but no longer exhausts it.
Greatness and force broaden the adjective to the full two-sided settlement.
Repaying an act with its consequence establishes the settlement relation.
A measure equal to its need or counterpart makes the punitive return fitting rather than arbitrary.
Counting and reckoning supply the accountability that the punished group did not anticipate.
Exhaustive enumeration closes gaps in the field being settled.
Binding inscription gives the exhaustive count durable judicial force.
Protection from harm opens the settlement's contrasting positive side.
Attaining good and escape defines the positive outcome as successful passage.
The repeated recompense term explicitly links the gift section to the earlier punitive settlement.
Giving and handing over make the positive return a bestowed outcome.
Sufficiency and abundance let حساب characterize gift as ample while retaining the accounting echo.

structural_cues: جزاء occurs at both 78:26 and 78:36, framing punishment and gift with the same settlement term.
حساب links the rejected reckoning of 78:27 with the ample or measured gift of 78:36.
The contrastive sections begin with إن at 78:21 and 78:31.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical mirrors across punishment and gift plus exhaustive recording; I infer one settlement architecture governing both outcomes. A live alternative reads حساب at 78:36 only as abundance, weakening but not erasing the cross-section echo.

changed_reading.before: The great report is primarily an announcement of overwhelming calamity.
changed_reading.after: The great report announces a comprehensive settlement in which fitting loss and protected, ample gift answer the entire recorded field of action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later context progressively removes false report, negligible noise, owned address, and unlicensed speech, leaving only permitted correct utterance. The report's greatness can therefore include jurisdiction over communication itself: it determines which speech finally has standing.

activation_trace.role: Brought and reported news anchors the model in communication rather than in an independent theme of silence.
Social standing and authority let greatness register the report's eventual jurisdiction among competing utterances.
Contradiction of truth supplies the false communicative mode excluded from the positive scene.
Auditory reception makes the absence of corrupt speech a transformed communication environment.
Speech cast aside as counting for nothing supplies the noise that no longer has standing.
Possession and power of disposal frame address as something speakers cannot independently control.
Exchange of address supplies the communicative capacity explicitly denied.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the act placed under restriction.
Permission licenses the exceptional utterance and makes speech jurisdictional.
Correctness settled opposite error defines the only speech granted final standing.

structural_cues: 78:35 negates hearing both negligible speech and false report.
78:37-38 moves from no possession of address to no speech except by permission and correctness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a narrowing sequence from excluded falsehood to controlled address and permitted correct speech; I infer that the report's greatness includes authority over the speech field. A live alternative treats the restrictions only as consequences within the scene, not as a dimension of the focus report.

changed_reading.before: One important report among many utterances in circulation.
changed_reading.after: The report that ultimately governs the communicative field, stripping false and unauthorized speech of standing and leaving only permitted correctness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes fertile or protective concealment from culpable truth-covering: night covers, gardens are enclosed, the sky opens, and the final rejecter is marked by concealment of truth. The report becomes a disclosure that discriminates between kinds of hiddenness rather than merely abolishing all covering.

activation_trace.role: The brought knowledge-bearing report anchors the model as disclosure.
An overwhelming or resisted matter explains why disclosure can provoke epistemic hiding.
Covering by clothing supplies a beneficial mode of concealment.
Concealment and enclosure supply a fertile hiddenness associated with gardens.
Opening what was closed supplies the large-scale reversal from enclosure to access.
Concealing truth supplies the culpable hiddenness that the report finally defeats.

structural_cues: Beneficial covering appears in the created-order catalogue before the sky is opened in the event sequence.
The final ayah pairs the truth-covering agent with direct sight of what was sent ahead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective covering, fertile enclosure, cosmic opening, and truth-concealment; I infer a graded concealment-to-disclosure mechanism. A live alternative treats these as unrelated local images with no bearing on the focus report.

changed_reading.before: A report that simply adds information to ignorance.
changed_reading.after: A discriminating disclosure that preserves generative hiddenness while opening what must be known and defeating concealment of truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true day and near warning culminate in each person looking at what the hands sent forward. The report crosses from conveyed information into self-authenticating encounter: its recipient finds the announced reality materially indexed by prior action.

activation_trace.role: Coming and emergence model the report's passage from elsewhere into present encounter.
Reported news supplies the initial mediated form that the final encounter overtakes.
The overwhelming matter supplies the recipient's final inability to keep the report at epistemic distance.
Reality fixed in correspondence with fact supplies the event's self-validating status.
A warning that awakens caution makes the report actionable before encounter.
Temporal nearness closes the imagined distance between warning and event.
Directed sight or insight converts mediated report into personal apprehension.
Advancing something ahead makes prior deeds arrive as already-prepared evidence.
What the hands earned locates the evidence in the recipient's own agency.

structural_cues: 78:39 identifies the day as the reality, and 78:40 immediately makes the warning near.
The final scene moves from second-person warning to a generic person seeing and then to the rejecter's first-person wish.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed reality, near warning, direct sight, and deeds sent ahead by one's own hands; I infer that the report becomes a self-authenticating encounter. A live alternative keeps deeds as evidence within the event rather than identifying their encounter with the report's arrival.

changed_reading.before: Secondhand information that can remain an object of debate.
changed_reading.after: A near reality that arrives as direct sight of one's own prior agency, eliminating the distance required for debate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the clear-path branch is form-distant from the ordinary news sense of النبإ. It remains anchored in the supplied focus branch and is activated by 78:39's acquired return toward the Lord; downstream prose should present it as a route metaphor, not as a lexical replacement for 'report'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The model attaches to the clear-path branch of ن ب ء in the focus noun.

activation_trace.role: A clear path leading where one intends lets the report function as traversable orientation.
Greatness and strength give that orienting route existential consequence.
Taking or acquiring supplies the reader's active adoption of a route.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply the destination's relational character.
Return to a destination completes the path mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The report is only an object people discuss.
changed_reading.after: The report also offers an orienting route that a person may actively take toward return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the faint-sound branch of ن ب ء is remote from the focus noun's normal report sense. It remains anchored by that explicit focus branch, العظيم's force, the horn-blast sequence, and the later hearing regime; downstream prose should call it an acoustic activation rather than translate النبإ as 'sound'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reading joins the focus root's faint, uncertain sound branch to the adjective's strength branch.

activation_trace.role: A faint uncertain sound supplies the report's initially indistinct acoustic register.
Greatness and strength turn the faint register into a latent capacity for overwhelming force.
Sending wind into an instrument supplies the force that converts potential sound into signal.
The blowing horn gives the acoustic escalation a concrete event instrument.
Auditory perception makes the later absence of corrupt sound part of the same acoustic field.
Mixed noisy sound supplies the disordered acoustic mode excluded after the signal.

changed_reading.before: The report is treated only as semantic content.
changed_reading.after: The report carries an acoustic trajectory from indistinct circulation through a forceful gathering signal into an ordered field without corrupt noise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because العظيم is usually heard evaluatively, whereas its supplied bulk or greater-part branch makes scope rather than rank salient. It remains anchored by the adjective and by 78:29's totality, exhaustive count, and record; downstream prose should retain it as a comprehensive-account nuance, not insist that 'great' simply means 'all-inclusive'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reading attaches العظيم to the supplied branch meaning the bulk, main part, or greater portion.

activation_trace.role: The consequential report supplies the document-like content whose scope can expand.
The bulk or greater part shifts greatness from rank toward comprehensive scope.
Total enclosure and completion supply the report's all-embracing extent.
Exhaustive counting turns broad scope into itemized completeness.
Joining one unit to another gathers the enumerated total into a single record.

changed_reading.before: Greatness means only unusually high importance.
changed_reading.after: Greatness may also mark the report's comprehensive bulk: an account that gathers the whole recorded field rather than one isolated headline.

strongest_changes: Questioning, divergent paths, and doubled future knowing turn the phrase into a movement from contested report to unavoidable disclosure.
Created transformations and the appointed separation make the report materially rehearsed and temporally scheduled.
Mirrored recompense and reckoning language revises a calamity-only reading into a comprehensive two-sided settlement.
The true day and sight of one's own prior deeds collapse the distance between reported information and witnessed consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a change of medium: circulating report becomes material pattern, appointed event, exhaustive settlement, regulated speech, and finally self-witness. Form-distant focus branches also kept route, acoustic, and totalizing readings live without treating them as ordinary glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The metonymic boundary between the report and the event it announces remains movable.
It remains uncertain how much العظيم marks objective magnitude, recipient overwhelm, comprehensive scope, or all three concurrently.
The speech-jurisdiction and graded-concealment models may describe consequences of the event rather than intrinsic dimensions of the focus report.
